summary.content:
Today's selection covers 68 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 44 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI let ChatGPT aid and abet mass shooters, Florida lawsuit claims
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Hackers hijack thousands of sites for ClickFix and FakeUpdate attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
